provenance.method: Bounded review of ADHD UK's current support-group registration page; listing records peer access without asserting therapeutic effect.

name: ADHD UK support groups
description: ADHD UK route for registering for its support-group events and updates.
intended_use: Finding an ADHD-specific peer-support option to inspect alongside other community routes.
audience_or_context: People seeking ADHD-related peer support in the UK; event format, capacity and eligibility should be checked for each session.
limitations: A peer support group is not diagnosis, therapy or crisis care.
Social format and group fit vary by person and event.
cost_or_access_notes: The reviewed page describes support-group tickets as free, with donations invited; check current event details.
conflicts_of_interest: ADHD UK operates the groups and has an organisational interest in participation and donations; ND Oracle lists the access route without endorsing outcomes.
